findings.highlight: you'll always find something different than what you expected in the beginning.
findings.evidenceJa: けど、入って一月なんて、まだ見習いもいいところじゃない
findings.explanation: The reassurance continues: after only one month Tomo is still very much an apprentice. Todokanai TL drops that concrete calibration and leaves the quotation open, weakening why her dissatisfaction is premature.
findings.japanese:
「まぁ、最初のうちは色々とギャップ感じるよね。
けど、入って一月なんて、
まだ見習いもいいところじゃない」
findings.todokanai: "Well, you'll always find something different than what you expected in the beginning.

findings.highlight: Such as the mixer just the other day.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな人脈作れるのかって期待して行ったらさぁ、ＡＤクラスしかいなくってさぁ
findings.explanation: Tomo went expecting useful industry connections and found that every man there was only an assistant director. Todokanai TL omits the entire complaint and leaves only the event name, so the others' disbelief has no translated cause.
findings.japanese:
「例えばこないだの合コンよ。
どんな人脈作れるのかって期待して行ったらさぁ、
ＡＤクラスしかいなくってさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Such as the mixer just the other day.

findings.highlight: And to think they wanted to split the bill at such a cheap place.
findings.evidenceJa: しかもそんな価値もない飲みでワリカンとか終わってる。そんなんで二次会ったって誰が行くかってのよ、ねぇ？
findings.explanation: Tomo says an equally split bill made the worthless drinking party hopeless and asks who would attend its afterparty. Todokanai TL changes value into venue cheapness, omits the afterparty refusal, and leaves the quote unfinished.
findings.japanese:
「もうガッカリもいいとこ。
しかもそんな価値もない飲みでワリカンとか終わってる。
そんなんで二次会ったって誰が行くかってのよ、ねぇ？」
findings.todokanai: "I couldn't be more disappointed! And to think they wanted to split the bill at such a cheap place.

findings.highlight: An alumni meeting of former Miss Houjou winners.
findings.evidenceJa: 歴代ミス峰城大付の同窓会
findings.explanation: Tomo calls the trip a reunion of successive Miss Houjou University High titleholders. Todokanai TL reduces the school-specific title to generic 'Miss Houjou winners,' erasing the university-affiliated-school identity used throughout the work.
findings.japanese:
「ほんっと楽しみだなぁ。
歴代ミス峰城大付の同窓会。
findings.todokanai: "I'm so excited. An alumni meeting of former Miss Houjou winners.

findings.evidenceJa: それじゃ阿多良温泉で決定
findings.explanation: The same destination is Atara Hot Springs at line 67. Todokanai TL changes it to Arata here, giving one location two spellings fourteen lines apart and breaking searchable continuity.
findings.japanese:
それじゃ阿多良温泉で決定！
なお、完全男子禁制で」
findings.todokanai: Alright, Arata hot springs it is then! No men allowed whatsoever."

findings.evidenceJa: 春希のこと、全部許すのも受け入れるのもいいけど、あいつの説教癖まで抱え込まなくていいから
findings.explanation: Io tells Setsuna that forgiving and accepting all of Haruki is one thing, but she need not absorb his compulsive lecturing too. Todokanai TL omits the entire line after the address, deleting the established Haruki trait that Setsuna has begun reproducing.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜さぁ…
春希のこと、全部許すのも受け入れるのもいいけど、
あいつの説教癖まで抱え込まなくていいから」

findings.highlight: I'll get someone else to take care of him.
findings.evidenceJa: うん、ちゃんと切り替える
findings.explanation: Setsuna promises she will properly switch mental gears and be present on the trip. Todokanai TL invents an arrangement for somebody else to care for Haruki, changing her internal decision into an unstated logistical plan.
findings.japanese:
「うん、ちゃんと切り替える。
…わたしね、最近気づいたんだ」
findings.todokanai: "It's okay, I'll get someone else to take care of him. …I realized, just recently."

findings.highlight: I mean, I want to be happy with everyone.
findings.evidenceJa: だから仕事も一生懸命やる。遊びだって手を抜かない
findings.explanation: Setsuna concludes that she will work with all her strength and refuse to neglect play either. Todokanai TL omits both commitments and leaves the quotation open, removing the practical definition of her resolve to sacrifice nothing.
findings.japanese:
「わたしはね、何も犠牲にしたりしないよ？
だって、みんなで幸せになりたいから。
だから仕事も一生懸命やる。遊びだって手を抜かない」
findings.todokanai: "I'm not going to sacrifice anything. I mean, I want to be happy with everyone.

findings.highlight: I just go with the flow without deciding anything.
findings.evidenceJa: その結果、雪菜を、かずさを、みんなを傷つけてさ
findings.explanation: Haruki's indecision has a stated result: he hurt Setsuna, Kazusa, and everyone. Todokanai TL drops the complete consequence and leaves the sentence hanging, softening the guilt that motivates his request for Takeya's judgment.
findings.japanese:
「人にはすぐに結果を求めるくせに、
結局、自分では何一つ決められずに流されてばっかで。
その結果、雪菜を、かずさを、みんなを傷つけてさ…」
findings.todokanai: "I always demand that everyone else is at their best, yet when it comes to myself, I just go with the flow without deciding anything.

findings.highlight: people have the hardest time understanding themselves over anyone else.
findings.evidenceJa: だから間違った選択をするし、けれど人の間違いはよく見える
findings.explanation: Takeya says people make wrong choices because they see themselves least clearly, yet see other people's mistakes well. Todokanai TL keeps only the first premise, deleting the paradox that authorizes him to advise Haruki despite his own failures.
findings.japanese:
「だいたい人間、自分のことが一番見えてないもんだ。
だから間違った選択をするし、
けれど人の間違いはよく見える」
findings.todokanai: "To begin with, people have the hardest time understanding themselves over anyone else.

findings.highlight: And once that baptism is over and done with, I'll be next.
findings.evidenceJa: 安心しろ、一生返せないくらいの恩返しをしてもらうさ
findings.explanation: After Haruki apologizes to the people who truly deserve it, Takeya jokes that he will demand a debt of gratitude impossible to repay in a lifetime. Todokanai TL drops that affectionate escalation and leaves the quotation unfinished.
findings.japanese:
「で、そっちの禊が終わったら次に俺な。
安心しろ、一生返せないくらいの恩返しをしてもらうさ」
findings.todokanai: "And once that baptism is over and done with, I'll be next.
